summary: Alertmanager's Telegram delivery, severity routing, wedge inhibition and ESO file-based secrets meet P2's outcome; the rendered config passes amtool 0.34.1 and the deploy path cannot deadlock on the post-helm ExternalSecret. One advisory: an inhibited stall alert's resolve is never delivered.

findings.summary: A stall alert delivered before its node's wedge warning fires never gets a [RESOLVED] notice once inhibited
